title: SubmarketIndex
description: Historical submarket or property-class performance indexed to the overall market. E.g., Denver CBD occupancy was 100.7% of Denver market average in 2025.

index_name.description: Submarket name (e.g., 'Denver CBD') or property class (e.g., 'Luxury', 'Upper Upscale').

occupancy_index.description: Decimal index where 1.00 = market average. E.g., 1.007 = 100.7% of market.

percent_of_market.description: Share of total market room count (decimal). E.g., 0.26 = 26%.
